{{Quote|Keep them alive, Grammel. Whether you go to hell or glory is dependent on how well you carry out these orders.|Governor Bin Essada|<ref name="SotME">''[[Splinter of the Mind's Eye]]''</ref>}}
'''Glory''' was the opposite of [[Chaos/Legends|hell]]. As hell, or Chaos as it is sometimes called in [[Corellia/Legends|Corellian]] mythology, was a place of darkness and torment, glory was presumably a place of light and peace.<ref name="SotME" />
